title: Tide and Postcard
author: Paloma Dravenmoor
blurb: Rafael Ashgrove, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
